summary: The workflow runs on Python 3.9, but the project requires Python 3.11 or newer, so installing dependencies fails.
likely_cause: The actions/setup-python step pins Python 3.9, which does not satisfy the project's requires-python constraint of >=3.11, so pip refuses to install the package.

evidence.quoted_text: 2024-06-01T12:00:08.9999999Z ERROR: Package 'pipelinelens' requires a different Python: 3.9.18 not in '>=3.11'

suggested_changes.description: Use a Python version that satisfies the project's requires-python constraint (3.11 or newer).
suggested_changes.details: Set python-version to 3.11 (or a newer supported version) in the setup-python step.

verification_steps: Re-run the failed workflow after bumping the Python version and confirm the Install dependencies step no longer reports 'requires a different Python'.
Optionally add a version matrix (for example 3.11 and 3.12) to confirm the project installs on every supported interpreter.
